launch_slurm_job: launch a Slurm job by submitting an sbatch script with GPU nodes and conda environment
copy_python_dir: copy only Python files from an input directory to an output directory using rsync
retrieve_partition_max_time: retrieve the maximum time limit in minutes for each Slurm partition via sinfo
validate_stool_args: validate StoolArgs by setting default time limits and formatting SBATCH constraint flags
run_stool_cli: run the stool CLI module to submit a training job to a Slurm cluster with a config file
